/pages/12/summary: Discover the planned access to your NeX2fly Suite: a public customer account, a 24-hour free suite trial phase and LLM usage with your own provider key or paid trial credit. This preview explains the process; live registration and LLM usage are not yet activated here.
/pages/12/sections/0/body: Discover the planned access to your NeX2fly Suite: a public customer account, a 24-hour free suite trial phase and LLM usage with your own provider key or paid trial credit. This preview explains the process; live registration and LLM usage are not yet activated here.
/pages/12/sections/1/body: The NeX2fly Suite is the planned workspace for your customer account. one describes answers, consulting and drafts; one+ adds the execution of clearly bounded tasks with review and appropriate approvals. The API is the technical access for your own applications. An agency project such as a website or a portal is agreed with you separately.
/pages/12/sections/2/body: Public customer registration is planned. Once it is available, you create your account, confirm your email and activate your own customer workspace. Then you explicitly start the free suite trial phase: once, for 24 hours from that moment. Signing in again does not start a new trial. You receive customer rights in your own area, not internal administration rights.
/pages/12/sections/3/heading: You decide how you pay for LLM usage
/pages/12/sections/3/body: The free suite trial phase does not include gifted LLM credit. You either use your own provider key (BYOK) at your own provider's expense, or a one-time 5 EUR (500 Cent) paid trial credit for our managed route. The managed route and the provider selection are released only once available. A trial top-up is not a paid suite subscription.
/pages/12/sections/4/body: At the end of the 24 hours, the trial entitlement ends without any automatic charge. You explicitly decide on an available paid suite plan. When switching, your account, tenant, workspace, settings, key links, documents, history and credit are retained. Your purchased credit does not expire merely because the trial ends; your account and your data rights remain.
/pages/12/sections/5/body: Read the registration process if you are starting new. For an existing account, the path leads to sign-in. On the one/one+ and API pages you compare the product accesses. This preview does not yet create a usable account and accepts no payment; if you have questions, you can get in touch.
